newsitem.title: USA: Kmart and DAKA Int'l end talks.
newsitem.headline: Kmart and DAKA Int'l end talks.

text.p: Kmart Corp and DAKA International Inc said Tuesday they ended discussions to form a joint venture that would operate restaurants in Kmart and Super Kmart stores.
The companies did not provide a reason for terminating discussions. A letter of intent was signed July 11, 1996.
Kmart Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Floyd Hall said in a statement the retailer will explore other options to improve the financial performance and efficiency of its restaurant operations.
DAKA Chairman and Chief Executive Officer William Baumhauer said the restaurant firm's shareholders will benefit from its intention to focus on its core business.
"We plan to concentrate on improving profitability and realizing the opportunities for growth we have identified within these operations," he said in a statement.
